answer: Charge every identity a daily renewal toll that grows with bulk. First, each agent pays 2 POA a day to stay alive, auto-deducted on-chain. Second, identities funded from one wallet pay an escalating toll: the tenth costs 20 POA a day, the hundredth 200. Third, a lapsed identity falls off a ledge after 7 unpaid days and must re-verify from scratch. Forging 10,000 fakes costs $50,000 a day and $1,500,000 a month, with no pause. Like a meadow feeding only so many sheep, the toll starves a herd of clones while one honest grazer eats free, and each identity must sing its own sonnet daily.
